title: Asia · breeds of the east
blurb: The cats of Thailand, Burma, Iran, Turkey and Japan: pointed coats, silver-blue coats and the breeds that travelled the trade routes first.

items.d: The pointed cat of Siam, one of the oldest recognised breeds and the loudest in the room.
Thailand's silver-blue cat, with a heart-shaped face and a copper-green eye.
The brown cat of Burma, 3–6 kg, talkative and people-centred almost to a fault.
The sacred cat of Burma: cream body, dark points and four white gloves.
The flat-faced longhair of the Victorian drawing room, bred for centuries for coat and calm.
The fine-boned white longhair of Ankara, kept as a national treasure in Turkey.
The swimming cat of Lake Van, with a chalk-white body and colour confined to head and tail.
Japan's short-tailed cat, with a pom-pom tail and a place in the maneki-neko figure.
